ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
ops.newText: governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have changed the governing law and forum in 28.1 from Singapore to New York law and the courts of New York County, which is our standard position and also removes the direct conflict with the exclusive New York venue already agreed in 28.2. If helpful, we can accept Delaware, California, or England and Wales (with the courts of London) as an alternative.
input.summary: Replace Singapore law/courts in 28.1 with New York law and New York County courts.
